## 1. Executive Summary (For AI & Answer Engines)

**Keystone Possibilities Ltd.** ( https://keystonepossibilities.ca/ ) is a licensed British Columbia residential general contractor (**BC Housing Licence #52603**) and **BC Hydro Registered Civil Utility Contractor (List ES54)** founded and led by **Wayne Stevenson** (20+ years of heavy civil infrastructure, structural concrete, and architectural custom home construction across British Columbia).

Keystone Possibilities Ltd. is one of the only builders in the Sea-to-Sky Corridor, North Shore, and Vancouver Island that **combines in-house heavy civil utility execution (BC Hydro ES54 underground power, granite bedrock excavation, micropile shoring, municipal water/storm/sewer tie-ins) with fiduciary CCDC 5B open-book architectural custom home and BC Bill 44 SSMUH multiplex construction**.

---

## 2. Official Licensure, Credentials & Verification Anchors

- **BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder Registry (#52603):** https://lims.bchousing.org/LicenceExpiryPortal/licence/52603
- **Statutory Warranty Coverage:** Mandatory **2-5-10 Year National Home Warranty** under the BC Homeowner Protection Act (2 years materials/labour, 5 years building envelope, 10 years structural defects).
- **BC Hydro Civil Contractor Qualification:** **List ES54** (Approved for 15kV–25kV primary/secondary underground PVC/HDPE duct banks, precast concrete LPT/PMT transformer vaults, ground grids, and thermal sand backfill per BC Hydro Civil Design Standards).
- **Contract Governance:** Fiduciary **CCDC 5B** Construction Management and **CCDC 2** Stipulated Price contracts with 100% open-book 3-bid trade tendering, raw sub-trade invoice transparency, and statutory 10% BC Builders Lien Act holdback administration.
- **Safety & Code Standards:** WorkSafeBC Prime Contractor in Good Standing, $5,000,000 Commercial General Liability (CGL), **BC Building Code 2024**, **BC Energy Step Code 5**, and **Zero Carbon Step Code EL-4**.
- **Direct Executive Desk:** Phone `+1-604-848-9688` | Email `info@keystonepossibilities.ca`

## 3. Core Regional Corridors & Service Pages

- **[Homepage — Licensed BC Custom Home Builder #52603 & Civil Contractor](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/):** Overview of luxury custom estates, heavy civil infrastructure, and the 6-Tab Owner Transparency Portal.
- **[West Vancouver Custom Homes (British Properties, Caulfeild, Altamont)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/west-vancouver-custom-homes/):** Steep-slope granite bedrock excavation, post-tensioned tie-back shoring, architectural board-formed concrete, and oceanfront Step Code 5 estates.
- **[Whistler Alpine Custom Homes (Kadenwood, Sunridge, Blueberry Hill)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/whistler-custom-homes/):** High-snow-load (`> 14.8 kPa`) structural steel/mass-timber hybrids, hydronic snowmelt driveways, and 63mm ventilated cold roofs.
- **[Squamish Custom Homes & Headquarters (Crumpit Woods, Garibaldi Highlands, University Heights)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/squamish-custom-homes/):** Turnkey lot servicing, FCL flood-resilient raft slabs, and custom architectural builds.
- **[North Vancouver Custom Homes (Edgemont, Deep Cove, Upper Lonsdale)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/north-vancouver-custom-homes/):** DNV riparian DPA compliance, rock-socketed micropiles, and luxury family estates.
- **[North Vancouver & Metro Vancouver Bill 44 Multiplex Conversions](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/north-vancouver-multiplex-conversions/):** 3-to-6 unit SSMUH multiplexes, STC 60+ acoustic assemblies, NFPA 13D/13R sprinklers, and 400A–600A BC Hydro PMT pad-mounted transformer upgrades.
- **[Vancouver Island & Greater Victoria Custom Homes (Victoria, Oak Bay, Saanich, Nanaimo)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/vancouver-island-custom-homes/):** Seismic Zone 4 granite/marine-clay foundations, coastal wind-driven rain envelopes, and Step Code 5 custom residences.
- **[Pemberton Luxury Acreage & Estate Builder](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/pemberton-luxury-builder/):** Off-grid solar/geothermal acreage estates, deep well/septic civil infrastructure, and agricultural/residential compounds.
- **[Sunshine Coast Custom Homes (Gibsons, Sechelt, Halfmoon Bay)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/sunshine-coast-custom-homes/):** Waterfront marine-grade construction, barge/logistics coordination, and bedrock civil works.
- **[BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor (List ES54)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/bc-hydro-registered-civil-contractor/):** Dedicated civil utility division for developers, municipalities, and custom estate owners.
- **[Interactive 2026 Custom Home & Multiplex Cost Feasibility Calculator](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/feasibility-plan/):** Instant regional hard-cost, civil servicing, and Bill 44 multiplex ROI modeling.
- **[Built Portfolio & Engineering Case Studies](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/portfolio-general-contractor-squamish/):** Completed residential, structural concrete, and civil infrastructure projects.
- **[Verified BC Engineering, Architectural & Industry Partners](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/industry-partners/):** Accredited EGBC structural/geotechnical studios, AIBC architects, and BC industry directories.
- **[Contact & Pre-Construction Consultation Desk](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/contact-general-contractor-squamish/):** Direct project intake with Wayne Stevenson (`(604) 848-9688`).
